server.label: Server & HTTPS
server._serverIntro.label: The Yandex provider API must be exposed through a public HTTPS reverse proxy. Keep the HTTP listener on 127.0.0.1 when using Nginx on this host.
server.publicBaseUrl.label: Public HTTPS base URL
server._urlHelp.label: Example: https://smart.example.com. Do not add /provider/ to the base URL. Open only TCP 443 to the Internet; do not expose the ioBroker Admin UI or local adapter port.
server._providerUrl.label: Skill endpoint (copy into Yandex Dialogs)
server._oauthUrl.label: OAuth authorization URL
server._tokenUrl.label: OAuth token URL
server.bind.label: Bind address (local HTTP)
server.port.label: HTTP port
server.trustProxy.label: Trust local Nginx X-Real-IP for OAuth login limits
server.trustProxy.help: Enable only when Nginx connects locally and overwrites X-Real-IP with $remote_addr. Headers from non-local connections are always ignored.
oauth.label: OAuth 2.0
oauth._oauthHelp.label: Use two different credential sets: Client ID/Secret for the Yandex skill and login/password for the account-linking page. Existing credentials are never rotated automatically. Save any other pending changes before using a generate button.
oauth.oauthClientId.label: OAuth Client ID (Yandex skill)
oauth.oauthClientSecret.label: OAuth Client Secret
oauth.oauthLogin.label: Account linking login
oauth.oauthPassword.label: Account linking password
oauth.oauthUserId.label: Internal Yandex user ID
oauth._createOAuth.label: Generate initial credentials (empty fields only)
oauth._rotateLogin.label: Generate a new account-linking password
oauth._oauthNote.label: Save the settings after generation. Changing Client ID/Secret requires updating the Yandex skill. Changing the login password does not automatically revoke previously issued tokens.
callbacks.label: Callbacks & diagnostics
callbacks.callbackEnabled.label: Enable Yandex state callbacks
callbacks.callbackSkillId.label: Yandex skill ID
callbacks.callbackOauthToken.label: Yandex callback OAuth token
callbacks.debugActions.label: Enable extended action traces in logs
callbacks._callbackInfo.label: Optional callbacks send notifications for bound properties marked reportable. Never share OAuth tokens or unredacted action logs publicly.
devices.label: Devices & backup
devices._deviceInfo.label: Manage device types, bindings, bidirectional mappings, availability, preview and backup/restore in the separate “Yandex Smart Home” Admin tab. Settings saved here do not delete existing devices or mappings.
devices._github.label: Adapter documentation
